note: Exactly 55 independently reviewed missing P0 complete values per Catalan/Romanian catalogue: 107 unchanged candidates and 3 exact revisions. Bounded AI linguistic/source-static acceptance with source/author qualifications retained in review receipts; not native-human, runtime, layout or whole-language certification.
